name: Banana stem
description: The inner core of the banana trunk, sliced into rings — watery and faintly bitter.

tcm.note: No Chinese entry; read as cooling and diuretic.

ayurveda.note: Shita and mutrala (diuretic) — a classical food for urinary complaints and stones.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; taken as juice for the same purpose.
